Tissue analysis: Exploratory rule-based tissue labels using elemental ratios; discriminating-line analysis FDR correction. Spatial mapping: Single-element multi-element 2-D maps raster-scan datasets. Visualization: Publication-ready ggplot2 plots; custom theme_libs() wavelength color scale. Shiny app: Six-tab interactive explorer (ls_run_app()). Reproducible examples: ls_example_data() provides synthetic tissue, calibration, spatial datasets — instrument data required.
